description: Stockholm Full-timeAboutAt Uniplay, our vision is simple: Make Corporate Learning Fun.We're building something different — an AI-native company where games, data, and hyper-personalisation redefine how people learn and grow at work. Our product blends games, behavioral data, and AI agents into a living learning experience that adapts to employees and evolves with every organisation.We care less about titles and more about people who create, collaborate, and push limits.The roleAI isn't a feature we bolted on — it's the product. Agent workflows, source grounding, RAG, structured generation, and learning science are how we turn real company material into adaptive, game-based learning.We're looking for an AI Engineer to join the team building that machinery: researching what's possible, building it, evaluating it honestly, and shipping it to customers. It's a hands-on role for someone who moves from paper to prototype to production without needing three planning meetings first.What you'll doBuild AI learning pipelines end to end. From ingestion of source material to generated, adaptive learning content — research, build, ship, measure, improve, together with the rest of the engineering team.Work with messy, real knowledge sources. Documents, links, videos, internal company material. Turning that into something useful is the hard part, and it's what the team spends its days on.Build our evaluation infrastructure. Quality in generated learning content is not a vibe. Help us define how we measure it and make the numbers move.Improve the AI production system. Prompts, templates, orchestration, model selection, latency, cost, internal tooling. Find the bottlenecks and remove them.Add a strong voice to the roadmap. You'll have real influence over what we build next — and a direct line to the people making those calls.Work closely with the rest of the team. Engineers, product, design, and learning experts. You'll review each other's work, pair on hard problems, and share what you learn.What we're looking forReal experience shipping AI systems. You've built LLM-powered products that ran in production, with real users and real failure modes — not just notebooks and demos.Depth in the modern stack. RAG, agentic workflows, structured generation, evals, vector databases, knowledge graphs. You know where each one earns its keep and where it doesn't.Your own projects. You build things because you can't help it. Show us at least one — repo, demo, write-up, product. What you learned matters more than how polished it is.Extreme drive. You don't wait for permission. You make things happen and bring people along.Fast iteration. You prototype quickly, kill your own ideas when the data says so, and are comfortable with messy early-stage exploration.Strong engineering. TypeScript and/or Python. You write code others can build on.Curiosity about how people learn. The bottleneck to AI value isn't technology — it's human learning and behaviour change. If that thesis interests you, we'll get along.A team player. You share context, ask for help early, give useful feedback, and would rather the team ship something good than be right on your own.Clear communication in English. Swedish a plus.Why UniplayWork on AI that turns real company knowledge into learning experiences people voluntarily come back to.Global from day one — Sweden, Brazil, the UK, DACH.A small team where your work reaches production in days, not quarters.Direct collaboration with engineers, AI specialists, HR experts, and product designers.Stockholm-based, with the autonomy to work how you work best.Goodbye boring. Hello fun.Uniplay is the world’s first game-based, AI-powered learning platform designed to transform corporate learning into an engaging experience. Founded by Linus Blomberg, a gaming industry veteran, and Eric Francia, a serial entrepreneur, Uniplay merges advanced game design with microlearning and AI technology to create a revolutionary corporate training experience, poised to redefine the way professionals learn and grow. Uniplay is an AI-first company, headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden. Visit Uniplay.io to learn more. Show more Show less
